channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: In New Jersey, a woman's boyfriend intervenes in her traffic stop; a woman in Nevada is subjected to an expletive-laden tirade from a road raging driver; when a driver gets rammed on a Texas highway, her driving skills are put to the test; a motorcyclist in Brazil attempts a risky way of fending off bike thieves; a mother and toddler on a sidewalk in England are caught in the path of a wayward vehicle.
